top_concerns: Model is essentially an anisotropic RBF/Gaussian-mixture network; novelty over classical RBF/free-knot methods unaddressed, universal approximation is a Cybenko corollary
WFR 'gradient' is just the parameter-space chain rule; experiments use Adam/GD and never exercise the Fisher-Rao part, no convergence theory
Claim of recovering 3D Gaussian Splatting is not derived and there is no novel view synthesis experiment; heuristic interpretations are speculative
Experiments are toy 1D/2D, single seed, weak/untuned MLP and KAN baselines, no RBF/SIREN/Fourier-feature/hash-grid or numerical-solver comparisons
Scalability (curse of dimensionality, cost, ill-conditioned A_i), overfitting and ablations not studied; presentation has typos and over-claiming
